name: measured_20260907
description: Physical (LeRobot-normalized) to MuJoCo Menagerie joint map anchored at read-only encoder readings of the arm posed by hand at the model zero configuration (arm straight out horizontally forward, jaws opening vertically). Exact 4096 ticks/turn scale; per-joint zero offsets from the reference; gripper keeps the legacy affine endpoint map because the model cannot represent touching jaws.

shoulder_pan.verification: sign carried over from the legacy contract (FK invariant match); zero from the hand-held reference; direction not yet verified physically

shoulder_lift.verification: zero from the hand-held reference; sign +1 consistent with the arm resting upper-arm-up at low ticks

elbow_flex.verification: zero from the hand-held reference; sign +1 consistent with the forearm folded forward at high ticks

wrist_flex.verification: zero from the hand-held reference; sign +1 consistent with the gripper pitched down at rest

wrist_roll.verification: zero from the hand-held reference (jaws vertical, moving finger on top); sign +1 verified: user turned +94 deg by hand and the moving finger ended on top as in the sim

supersedes: act_coordinate_contract.json affine endpoint mapping (assumed calibration endpoints coincide with model joint limits; measured spans differ by up to 37 percent and three joints were a quarter turn off)
